bio_en: Natalia Matinian, elder sister of Satenik (widow of Prince Hovsep Arghutian), was inspired by patriotic and revolutionary ideas from youth. After the Tiflis gymnasium she studied midwifery in Moscow and on returning to Tiflis in 1890 immediately joined the work of the newly founded ARF. Kristapor Mikaelian, Zavarian and Rostom valued her devotion and discretion and entrusted her with responsible missions. She was arrested several times under the Golitsyn regime, and died in Tiflis in October 1925 after a long illness.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
